main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move of short bets (drift removed, short direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases' deviations summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 case-days and supporting check passing; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.283 (below 1), 44 cases (30 needed).
reading: Cases are short bets (a rise of the short forecast of at least 2 points from its low since the last bet) on every bar, the mean is over cases and its t sums the cases' deviations per UTC day, the drift is the coin's mean 1-day return over all its windows, and the supporting split puts |forecast| above the median in the larger half and at or below it in the smaller half.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.283 (below 1), 44 cases (30 needed)
